note: S/4HANA 2025, fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt#351 plan F6 live run through the server's ActivateObjects: two classes of the run's own in a transportable package, both already active, activated again as a group. Discovery lists /sap/bc/adt/activation/runs, so the run path ran: POST /activation/runs?method=activate&preauditRequested=true (201), the run's status with long polling (200, finished), then these results — chkl:messages with checkExecuted="false" activationExecuted="false" generationExecuted="true" and no message, the silent kind. The server then read GET /sap/bc/adt/activation/inactiveobjects once (200, neither class listed) and answered nothing_to_activate: true. The run id is the one SAP assigned.
